is_anopheles.evidence: Study evaluated Anopheles coluzzii reared from larval collections at Kou Valley (Page 2).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Tracked the Vgsc L1014F (L995F) mutation: 'The level of kdr mutation within a subsample of mosquitoes (N=291) was performed... Only the mutation L1014F was tracked' (Page 2).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Reports that '96.9% of the An. coluzzii used for bioassays carried the kdr resistance gene' (Page 3) out of a sample size of N=291 genotyped (Page 2).

african_field_population.evidence: Used F1 progeny of An. coluzzii reared from larval field collections at Kou Valley (11°23' N, 4°24' W), Burkina Faso (Page 2).

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary empirical research paper investigating bacterial infection impacts on Anopheles coluzzii larvae and adults.

sub_country_location.evidence: Kou Valley (11°23' N, 4°24' W), Burkina Faso (Page 2).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The exact year of mosquito larval collection is not reported in the text.

duplicate_risk.evidence: Routine new field collection of larvae from Kou Valley for laboratory bioassays.

supplement.evidence: The kdr genotype sample size (N=291) and overall frequency (96.9%) are reported in the main text.

assessment.summary: This study assessed the larvicidal and reproductive impacts of Chromobacterium anophelis IRSSSOUMB001 on field-derived Anopheles coluzzii from Kou Valley, Burkina Faso. Molecular characterization confirmed high pyrethroid resistance in the target population, with 96.9% carrying the Vgsc L1014F (L995F) kdr mutation (N=291).
